cma_evidence.title: KFERQ-like motif scan of P05181 sequence
cma_evidence.note: 5 KFERQ-like motifs detected in CYP2E1 (P05181) sequence by motif_finder module. Presence of canonical and variant KFERQ pentapeptides is the biochemical basis for CMA substrate classification. See Q9WMX2_vs_P05181_sea_report.md for runtime output.

known_autoantibody_epitopes.label: JHDN-5

critical_residues.note: Lys123 modification (adduct formation by reactive metabolite or drug) is required to break self-tolerance and induce hepatitis and CYP2E1 autoantibodies in mice. This is the most immunogenically sensitive residue in the epitope.

known_autoantibody_epitopes.notes: JHDN-5 is a novel MHC II-restricted immunodominant epitope shared between halogenated anesthetic-induced hepatitis and viral (HCV) hepatitis. IgG4 against Gly113-Leu135 is independently associated with severe hepatic fibrosis in HCV-positive patients (P=0.0142 after covariate adjustment, ALIVE cohort n=200). Antiserum against JHDN-5 recognizes mitochondria and endoplasmic reticula, upregulates HSP27, induces mitochondrial oxidative stress via complex I inhibition (P<0.001), and inhibits CYP2E1 activity. Pipeline McLachlan analysis found independent hits at viral positions mirroring host positions 123-129 and 130-136, corroborating the epitope range without prior knowledge of this literature.

evidence.authors: McCarthy LR, Mukherjee R, Bhatt DL, et al.
evidence.title: Identification of a Novel MHC-Restricted CYP2E1 Epitope Associated with Anesthetic and Viral Hepatitis

known_autoantibody_epitopes.label: conformational_epitopes_ALD_CHC
known_autoantibody_epitopes.notes: Anti-CYP2E1 autoantibodies in ALD and CHC target conformational epitopes located in close proximity on the molecular surface. Detectable in approximately one-third of patients with advanced ALD and CHC. Presence is an independent predictor of extensive necro-inflammation and fibrosis and worsens hepatitis recurrence following liver transplantation. Epitopes are expressed on the hepatocyte plasma membrane where antibody-mediated cytotoxicity can occur.

evidence.authors: Sutti S, Vidali M, Albano E
evidence.title: CYP2E1 autoantibodies in liver diseases

known_mimicry_partners.notes: HCV polyprotein (Q9WMX2) N-terminal core region (approx. residues 40-150) contains sequences mimicking CYP2E1 Gly113-Leu135. Molecular mimicry is proposed as the mechanism for breaking self-tolerance against CYP2E1 during HCV infection. Pipeline McLachlan scoring identified three independent hits with host anchor at 123-129, 127-133, and 130-136 in this epitope range. The hit at host pos 123 (Lys, the critical modification site) is the highest-scoring of the three. See also CYP2A6 mimicry by HCV core 178-187 (Kammer 1999), which is a related but distinct finding involving CYP2A6 rather than CYP2E1.

P05181.notes: CYP2E1 is a hepatic microsomal enzyme responsible for oxidative biotransformation of low-molecular-weight xenobiotics (ethanol, halogenated anesthetics, acetaminophen) and endogenous substrates. It is the primary autoimmune target in ALD, CHC, and halogenated anesthetic-induced hepatitis. Its expression is induced by ethanol, obesity, and diabetes. CYP2E1 is transported to the hepatocyte plasma membrane via secretory vesicles, where surface-expressed CYP2E1 can be targeted by circulating autoantibodies, enabling antibody-mediated cytotoxicity.

known_mimicry_partners.notes: HCV polyprotein core region (approx. residues 40-150) contains sequences with McLachlan physicochemical similarity to CYP2E1 (P05181) Gly113-Leu135 epitope. Three independent scored hits: (1) viral 2525-2531 vs host 123-129, score 16.66; (2) viral 953-959 vs host 130-136, score 16.13; (3) viral 676-682 vs host 127-133, score 15.05. Additionally, Super-Epitope #10 in the SEA report maps viral pos 110 to host pos 123 (Lys123 — the critical immunogenic residue). Note: HCV core 178-187 (LLALLSCLTV) is separately reported to mimic CYP2A6 residues 8-17 at the CTL level (Kammer 1999) — this is a distinct finding from the CYP2E1 mimicry.

evidence.title: Q9WMX2 vs P05181 McLachlan SEA analysis
evidence.note: 134 filtered hits (composite_primary >= 15.0), 18 SUPER_EPITOPE tier, overall risk CRITICAL, top score 20.2898. See Q9WMX2_vs_P05181_sea_report.md.

Q9WMX2.notes: HCV polyprotein is a ~3000-residue precursor cleaved by viral and host proteases into structural (Core, E1, E2) and non-structural (NS2-NS5B) proteins. The core protein N-terminus (approx. residues 40-150) is implicated in molecular mimicry of hepatic CYPs, contributing to autoimmune hepatitis during chronic HCV infection. See Sutti 2014 for mechanism overview. Viral KFERQ-like motifs: 7 detected by pipeline (see SEA report).
